newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-FEYENOORD-AJAX START DELAYED AMID VIOLENCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FEYENOORD-AJAX START DELAYED AMID VIOLENCE.

text.p: The Dutch first division clash between Feyenoord and rivals Ajax Amsterdam was delayed for up to 15 minutes on Sunday as police tried to get supporters into the ground.

Fans earlier threw a fire-bomb at police in the centre of the city, and a group of Ajax fans arriving by train pelted police with ball-bearings. Mounted police charged supporters, making at least 10 arrests, Dutch ANP news agency said.
Two police officers were hurt in the clashes, ANP said.

Nearer the Feyenoord ground, in the south of the city, the bus carrying the Ajax team to the match came under attack from over 100 rival fans who threw stones, bottles and sticks, breaking one of the coach's windows and nearly injuring Ajax defender Menno Willems, the agency said.
Kick-off, scheduled for 1430 GMT, was put back by up to 15 minutes so that fans could enter the ground safely, Dutch radio said.
The mayor of Rotterdam earlier gave police special powers to arrest anyone looking like a football fan who was seen as a threat to public safety.
